connections.raw_vertical_bits: 5J QC12=V6, QD11=V7 before 5L flip/address XOR gates.
connections.INTD: 4K LS86 input12=V7, input13=V6; output11 to I/O P10:3, CPU CP3:3 and CPU vector mux. INTD=V6 XOR V7.
connections.request_stage: 2K LS00 input5=V7, input4=INTD, output6=NQ=NOT(V7 AND INTD).
connections.INTR: 2K LS00 input9=NQ, input10=4G Qbar8=VB_n; output8 to I/O P10:1 and CPU CP3:1. INTR=NOT(NQ AND VB_n).
connections.cpu_latch: 3D LS74 D2=8080 INTE16, CLK3=CP3:1 INTR, PRE_n4=+5V, Q5=8080 INT14.
connections.irq_clear: 3E LS174 Q1pin2 is positive INTA status latched from CPU D0 at STSTB; to 4D LS04 input5/output6, then 3D CLR_n1. CLR_n=NOT INTA. C20=300pF on INTR clock.
connections.vector_mux: LS153 A:B table selects11 for interrupt. Bits D0,D1,D2,D6,D7 are high; D3=INTD via2Z 2C3pin3, D4=NOT INTD via4D11/10 to3Z 1C3pin3, D5=ground via3Z 2C3pin3. Thus INTD=1 givesCF/RST1, INTD=0 givesD7/RST2.
connections.reset: CPU RESET12 receives CP2/P9:49. I/O TP6/P9:49 source is5D LS123 Q6 through two5F LS14 inverters3/4 and5/6; pulse width/trigger and power-up alignment are not qualified. CPU RESET is not drawn on3D interrupt CLR; physical raster counter CLR/LOAD held high in qualified counter trace.

supported_equations.INT: While INTA high:0. Otherwise on positive INTR edge:sample INTE. Retain Q between edges.
supported_equations.vertical_increment: On CK/4 positive edge with HB_n=1 and4J RCO15=1;5I/5J enabled cascade. V4 rising clocks VB, D=V5 AND V6 AND V7.

steady_events.counter_event: Active-end horizontal carry on common CK/4; downstream counter/XOR/NAND propagation.
Active-end horizontal carry; V4 rise clocks VB LS74, followed by Qbar/NAND propagation.

steady_request_intervals: INTR high at raw V128..191 and240..255/0..15, low16..127 and192..239, using qualified steady VB. Falling edges at16 and192 do not clock3D.
independent_uncertainties: Physical power-up state of free-running counters, VB and IRQ latch is not established by an artificial reset in isolated benches.
CPU RESET pulse and CPU first-fetch observation do not establish common CPU/raster reset or visible x/y/master origin.
At127->128 V6 andV7 both change; XOR/NAND transient propagation and INTE setup/hold require electrical timing. At239->240 VB adds a downstream latch stage.
INTD is live combinational data, not a proven vector register captured on request. Late acknowledge can select a different stable vector interval.
Exact Sheriff revision applicability and buffer/interconnect/C20 delays remain conditional.
No conclusion assigns first IRQ to a particular absolute master tick, changes saved field66 return-PC evidence, or selects a MAME-matching offset.

current_board_inspection.scope: Current behavioral board starts v240, asserts at pixel_phase0/h0 for v128/240, samples INTE and registers vector, clears cpu_ack; this inspection is not physical qualification.
